Non-Linear Structural Benchmarking of 3D Printed Titanium TPMS Lattices for Patient-Specific Orthopaedic Scaffold Design

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation Patient-specific
Aaron Vance, Oluwarotimi Lawal, Abul Arafat, Abhishek Gupta, John Robinson et al. Bioprinting 2026-08-01 10.1016/j.bprint.2026.e00498
单位: Additive Manufacturing Research Group, University of Wolverhampton, Telford Innovation Campus, Telford TF2 9NT, UK
通讯: Aaron Vance @ Additive Manufacturing Research Group, University of Wolverhampton, Telford Innovation Campus, Telford TF2 9NT, UK
相关性: 该论文直接针对3D打印钛合金TPMS点阵结构进行力学性能表征与多准则优化，与AM生物医用材料方向高度相关。
边界: 该论文未涉及应力遮挡或刚度匹配的定量分析，也未报告疲劳性能、表面粗糙度或骨整合相关数据。
动机· 为患者特异性骨科支架设计提供系统化的TPMS点阵结构实验基准。
方法· 制备54种Ti-6Al-4V TPMS点阵，进行准静态压缩测试，结合AHP-TDD-TOPSIS框架进行多准则排序。
结果· 弹性模量6.3-107 GPa，屈服强度125-1030 MPa，壁厚和单元尺寸显著影响力学性能，Diamond和Split-P能量吸收更高。
验证· 通过准静态压缩实验验证，并与Gibson-Ashby模型对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To provide systematic experimental benchmarking of TPMS lattices for guiding patient-specific orthopaedic scaffold design.
Method· Fifty-four Ti-6Al-4V TPMS lattices were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and tested under quasi-static compression, with results integrated into a hybrid AHP-TDD-TOPSIS decision-making framework.
Result· Effective modulus ranged from 6.3 to 107 GPa and yield strength from 125 to 1030 MPa, with wall thickness and unit cell size strongly influencing mechanical behavior; Diamond and Split-P lattices showed higher energy absorption than Gyroid.
Validation· Validation was performed through quasi-static compression testing and comparison with Gibson-Ashby scaling predictions.

Hybrid-Adaptive Thread Tuning to Mitigate Simulation Execution Bottlenecks in High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Inference

High RL & World Models arxiv Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark Exp. validation
Jiming Su, Hantao Hua, Lujia Yin, Yiping Yao, Feng Zhu arXiv preprint 2026-08-06 link
相关性: 该论文将世界模型/RL与物理仿真结合，通过自适应线程调优提升仿真推理效率，对用户基于FEA的植入物设计优化中的仿真加速具有潜在借鉴意义。
边界: This paper focuses on system-level thread tuning for RL inference in generic simulation environments, not on surrogate modeling for biomechanical FEA or implant design, and lacks any biomedical or structural mechanics context.
动机· 仿真在环RL推理受仿真器线程配置影响，现有方法难以动态匹配资源。
方法· 提出AutoThread，用PINO预测线程数，结合M/M/1排队模型约束，并在线微调。
结果· 相比静态策略平均加速18.4%，吞吐量达1.7-1.8倍，执行时间减少83.8%。
验证· 在多个仿真负载上对比静态、XGBoost和Reinforcer方法。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Simulation-in-the-loop RL inference is often bottlenecked by simulator-side execution overhead, and static thread configurations fail to adapt to dynamic workloads.
Method· The paper introduces AutoThread, a hybrid adaptive thread-tuning method that uses a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) as a thread-count predictor, constrained by a finite-source M/M/1 queueing model, and performs load-aware online fine-tuning.
Result· AutoThread achieves an average speedup of 18.4% over static strategies, throughput of 1.7x and 1.8x over XGBoost and Reinforcer, and reduces execution time by up to 83.8% compared to state-of-the-art methods.
Validation· The method is validated through experiments on dynamic simulation workloads, comparing against static, XGBoost, and Reinforcer baselines.

相关性: 该论文提出了一种多保真建模框架，用于预测氢环境下的钢断裂韧性，其方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
边界: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or any biomedical context; it focuses on hydrogen embrittlement of steel, and the surrogate model is not validated on implant-related FEA cases.
动机· 氢脆是钢结构的严重失效模式，需快速准确评估断裂韧性。
方法· 构建基于相场断裂的有限元高保真模型和解析低保真模型，结合多保真回归预测断裂韧性。

Motivation· Hydrogen embrittlement poses a critical threat to steel structures, necessitating rapid and accurate estimation of fracture toughness in hydrogen environments.
Method· A multi-fidelity framework integrates a phase-field finite element model for high-fidelity data and an analytical low-fidelity model, combined via a multi-fidelity regression approach.
Result· The proposed multi-fidelity model outperforms support vector regression, kernel ridge regression, and Gaussian process regression in prediction accuracy, and remains robust across loading rates.
Validation· The model is validated against numerical benchmarks using synthetic data from the high-fidelity FE model, with no experimental or clinical validation.

Motivation· This scoping review aims to synthesize the state of physics-informed digital twins in computational engineering, focusing on learning methods, uncertainty quantification, and deployment readiness.
Method· Following the PRISMA-ScR framework, the authors systematically reviewed 79 scholarly reports across six research questions, appraising evidence quality and proposing a non-compensatory evidence-gate procedure for method selection.

Motivation· Existing parameterized PINNs suffer from inefficient training and poor generalization across parameter domains, motivating a continual-learning approach to improve accuracy and resource efficiency.
Method· The proposed CL-PINN sequentially learns PDE instances at different parameter values, integrating Bayesian-optimization-based active selection, dynamic loss weighting, sparse physics-constrained replay, and an optional parameter subnetwork.
Result· Multi-seed experiments on five benchmarks show that CL-PINN achieves higher and more balanced accuracy than fixed-sampling and grid-greedy baselines while reducing objective-loss queries.
Validation· Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks on a continuous function and four parameterized PDEs, with multi-seed evaluations under prescribed resource protocols.

Motivation· This study aims to fill the knowledge gap on how kinetically controlled austenite reversion affects the tribological stability of LPBF 18Ni-300 maraging steel.
Method· Samples aged at 610°C and 650°C were characterized by LOM, SEM, and XRD, and wear performance was evaluated via pin-on-disk testing.
Result· High-temperature aging improved wear resistance compared to as-built, but higher austenite content at 610°C promoted oxide layer detachment, increasing the coefficient of friction to 0.58 versus 0.44 at 650°C.

动机· 现有MPC在线优化计算开销大，难以用于快速动态系统。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The high computational cost of online optimization in Model Predictive Control limits its application to systems with fast dynamics and long horizons.
Method· The paper introduces CUDA MPC, a GPU-native framework that co-designs the optimization algorithm, execution model, and memory architecture, using parallel-in-horizon ADMM and a fused CUDA kernel.
